evals.prompt: I opened https://www.figma.com/design/aB12cD34eF56/Checkout?node-id=1234-56 and called the Figma API for that node, but the `nodes` map comes back empty even though the request succeeds. What's wrong?
assertions: Identifies that the share-URL node-id uses a dash (`1234-56`) but the API `ids=` param needs a colon (`1234:56`), so the id must be converted dash-to-colon
Notes that passing the dash form returns an empty `{"nodes":{}}` with an HTTP 200 (a silent miss), not an error

evals.prompt: What HTTP header do I send my Figma personal access token in for a REST call?
assertions: Uses the `X-Figma-Token: <token>` header with the raw token and explicitly NO `Bearer` prefix
Distinguishes this from `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, which is for OAuth 2.0 access tokens, not the personal access token

evals.prompt: Export a specific frame from a Figma file as a 2x PNG and save it locally.
assertions: Explains the response contains time-limited signed URLs that must be downloaded immediately, not stored/reused, because they expire

evals.prompt: I only need one frame's spec out of a huge Figma file. How do I fetch it efficiently without pulling the whole document?
assertions: Prefers the targeted `GET /v1/files/:key/nodes?ids=` endpoint over the whole-file `GET /v1/files/:key`, and bounds any whole-file read with `depth=`
Recommends batching multiple node ids into one comma-separated `ids=` request to avoid the 429 rate limit rather than one call per node

evals.prompt: My call to `GET /v1/files/:key/variables/local` returns 403, but the styles endpoint works fine on the same file and token. Why?
assertions: Explains the local-variables endpoint is Enterprise-plan only and requires the `file_variables:read` scope on the token
Notes the styles / components endpoints work on all plans, which is why they succeed
